q: 'Kitob' so'zining inglizcha tarjimasi qaysi?
To'g'ri gapni tanlang: 'She ___ a teacher.'
'I have been studying English ___ 2020.' gapda qaysi so'z to'g'ri keladi?
'Go' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli qaysi?
'Beautiful' so'zining o'zbekcha ma'nosi qaysi?
To'g'ri gapni tanlang: 'They ___ playing football now.'
'Yesterday' so'zining ma'nosi qaysi?
'If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.' gapda qaysi to'g'ri?
Ko'plik shaklini tanlang: 'child' so'zining ko'plik shakli qaysi?
'Although it was raining, we went outside.' gapdagi 'although' so'zi qanday ma'no beradi?
'Run' fe'lining III shakli (Past Participle) qaysi?
'Expensive' so'zining antonimi (qarama-qarshi ma'nosi) qaysi?
To'g'ri predlogni tanlang: 'I am interested ___ learning languages.'
'She has ___ finished her homework.' gapda qaysi so'z to'g'ri keladi?
'Weather' so'zining o'zbekcha ma'nosi qaysi?
To'g'ri gapni tanlang: 'By next year, I ___ graduated.'
'Although' va 'however' so'zlari qanday bog'lovchilar guruhiga kiradi?
'Borrow' va 'lend' so'zlari orasidagi farq nimada?
options: Borrow — qarz olish, lend — qarz berish
correct: Borrow — qarz olish, lend — qarz berish
